event_time_rule: second A/B symbol at episode_tick gap_ticks
D distractor and activation at gap_ticks + 2000000
sequence.model_input: 8-vector with only the received named channel set to its amplitude; all other coordinates zero; event is an impulse, never a held value

generator.field_encoding: UTF-8, pipe-delimited; seed, block, and counter use canonical base-10 ASCII integers with no leading zeros; split is exactly TRAIN or EVAL; draw_name is exactly DELTA or NU; fields contain no pipe byte
generator.ordinal_mapping: global ordinals 0..95 are TRAIN and 96..143 are EVAL; split_local_ordinal equals global ordinal for TRAIN and global ordinal minus 96 for EVAL; block=floor(split_local_ordinal/8)
generator.draw_mapping: one DELTA and one NU draw per split/block with counter=0; the sampled value is shared by all eight examples in that balanced block
generator.integer_mapping: interpret all 32 SHA-256 digest bytes as one unsigned big-endian integer and take modulo support_size
generator.primary_cell: split_local_ordinal mod 8; order_bit=floor(cell/4); gap_bit=floor(cell/2) mod 2; repetition=cell mod 2; target=1 iff order_bit==gap_bit; each order×gap cell has two examples per 8-example block

controls.nearby_distractor: N and D are noninformative channels; D is the activation event
controls.temporal_disruption: block_index=floor(split_local_ordinal/8); on odd blocks replace decoder_gap_ticks with 10000000-physical_gap_ticks; decoder event ticks are 0, decoder_gap_ticks, decoder_gap_ticks+1000000, decoder_gap_ticks+2000000; physical timestamps, event identities, targets, reward schedule, and eligibility ages remain unchanged
controls.reward_delay_assignment: For each TRAIN episode, delay_ticks is selected by split_local_ordinal modulo the ordered reward_lifecycle.delay_ticks list; the assignment is identical for every arm and seed at the same split-local ordinal. EVAL episodes receive no correctness reward and perform no reward settlement or parameter update.

decoder_timing.temporal_disruption_arm: decoder_tick follows the predeclared temporal_disruption mapping

controls.silent: governance fixtures only; no activation/reward and no model update

readout.equation: p=sigmoid(w dot z+b); predict 1 iff p>0.5; exact tie predicts 0

pcn.initial_V: V[i,j]=0.25 if i=j; 0.125 if i=j+4; else 0
event_transition: initialize inference z^(0)=z0 for this event
perform exactly four declared inference steps using current event impulse x
update V and c once after inference using final z and final prediction error
persist z=z^(4), current decoder tick, and event-local prediction state
pcn.silence: no state update occurs during silence; decay is applied once lazily at the next input reception
pcn.simultaneous_events: serially ordered by canonical event ID then child ordinal; each later same-tick event sees the preceding event state and dt=0
pcn.episode_initial_state: z=[0,0,0,0], previous_decoder_tick=0, empty history, eligibility, and credit
pcn.training_reset: episodic state resets after physical cleanup; per-arm/per-seed learned V,c,w,b persist between training episodes
pcn.evaluation_reset: same episodic reset; all trained parameters are frozen and hash-checked before and after evaluation

eligibility.local_contribution: g_i=clip((2*a-1)*(ell_i-ell_before_i),-1,+1), where ell_i=w dot z_i+b at reception and ell_before_i uses the same readout parameters immediately before this reception; readout parameters cannot change until the delayed reward settles
eligibility.uniform_baseline: q_i=1/n for each eligible event; same saved event vector and clipping
eligibility.recency_baseline: q_i=K(age_i)/max(1,sum_j K(age_j)); same saved event vector and clipping
eligibility.contribution_claim: local prediction-score delta proxy; not counterfactual causal identification
eligibility.capture: at irrevocable prediction; immutable per-input z, contribution factor, event ID, age, and readout snapshot
eligibility.empty_set: zero eligibility vector and later reward logged unattributed
eligibility.duplicate_delivery: stable per-episode reward message ID; duplicate applies zero additional updates

reward_lifecycle.oracle: evaluator-side correctness source runs only after immutable prediction
reward_lifecycle.payload_to_decoder: signed scalar only; no target or label
reward_lifecycle.delay_assignment: TRAIN only; index=split_local_ordinal mod delay_ticks.length; apply the same assigned delay to matched episodes across all arms and seeds. EVAL emits no correctness reward and performs no reward settlement or learner update.
reward_lifecycle.zero_delay: prediction and credit capture phase precedes reward origin/delivery/settlement at the same tick
reward_lifecycle.cleanup: at activation+16000001 after settle, withhold, or reject; serial next episode begins only after cleanup

attribution_specificity.replay: Offline efficacy analysis only, after the separately authorized full efficacy run: for every evaluation episode and each captured eligible input event, replay the frozen decoder from the episode initial state with exactly that decoder input reception omitted; retain all other input events at their original physical and decoder timestamps and retain the evaluator activation trigger even when omitting D. Apply no parameter, reward, or eligibility update during replay. This counterfactual omission replay is expressly excluded from the feasibility-only pilot.
attribution_specificity.event_influence: d_i=abs(ell_full-ell_without_i), where each logit is measured at the original activation trigger
attribution_specificity.event_credit_vector: q_i*v_i using the arm's predeclared credit weight q_i and v_i=(2*a-1)*concat(z_i,1)
attribution_specificity.event_credit_mass: m_i=sum(abs(q_i*v_i[j])) over all readout coordinates including bias
attribution_specificity.episode_score: sum_i(m_i*1[d_i>0.000001])/sum_i(m_i); denominator zero is invalid and yields INCONCLUSIVE
attribution_specificity.seed_score: unweighted arithmetic mean of episode_score over the 48 frozen evaluation episodes
attribution_specificity.paired_effect: per-seed specificity_N minus specificity_U or specificity_N minus specificity_R
attribution_specificity.learner_visibility: no counterfactual replay, evaluator influence, or specificity score is provided to the decoder or learner

bootstrap.index_mapping: unsigned big-endian digest integer modulo number_of_complete_seed_clusters
bootstrap.familywise_adjustment: Bonferroni across the two explicitly named primary_comparisons; each reported lower bound is the 97.5% paired-seed cluster percentile bound
bootstrap.effect_summary: equal-weight mean of paired seed effects

decision.threshold_equality: inclusive only for >= and <= conditions; strict CI lower bound must be >0
decision.aborted_seed: inconclusive; retain partial raw artifact and no replacement
decision.efficacy_scope: exploratory only; no reliable power claim because between-seed variance is unknown

cost_benefit.scalar_operation_counting: increment once for each executed scalar add, subtract, multiply, divide, or comparison in decoder, eligibility, reward, and lifecycle arithmetic; do not count loop/index operations, serialization, hashing, memory accesses, tanh, or exp as scalar operations; report tanh/exp and reads/writes separately; abort if per-event or per-episode ceilings are exceeded
cost_benefit.cost_per_correct: counted_scalar_ops / correct_discriminations; if correct_discriminations=0 report positive infinity
cost_benefit.tradeoff_rule: efficacy and attribution success conditions are necessary but insufficient; op and memory ratios must also pass; missing required measurement is inconclusive
cost_benefit.event_cost_fairness: matched physical input counts; exactly one activity-cost-proxy charge per received input, zero reward-settlement charge

resources.execution_passes: one workload pass and one byte-identical deterministic replay pass; reset the entire run to initial model parameters and episodic state before the second pass, reuse identical per-episode seeds and input bytes, compare canonical output digests, and abort on any mismatch

replay_digest.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; compact JSON Lines; one episode object followed by LF; ECMAScript JSON.stringify with no replacer or whitespace
replay_digest.episode_record_order: seed ascending, protocol arms array order, split TRAIN then EVAL, split_local_ordinal ascending

strict_json_profile.schema_profile: restricted documented Draft 2020-12 keyword subset; unknown schema keyword is a validator configuration error
